falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes below 4950 on any daily session
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows invalidates the bottom pattern match; the structure would no longer resemble a successful retest and would instead confirm a lower low sequence

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 implies controlled volatility; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic selling rather than capitulation/bottom formation, breaking the pattern's volatility signature

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while SPX is simultaneously below 5100
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would signal a flight-to-safety recession bid in bonds alongside equity weakness, invalidating the growth-scare-bottom narrative; the August 2024 bottom featured rising yields with stabilizing equities

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
